full_details.title: Copy-Paste Data Entry Task
full_details.full_description:
I have a straightforward copy-paste assignment and need a detail-oriented freelancer who can move text and numbers from assorted source files into a single, well-structured spreadsheet. Accuracy is everything—each cell must mirror the original content without omissions or extra spaces, and the layout must remain tidy so I can analyse the data later.

Volume is moderate; think of it as roughly one small stack of documents, not a never-ending backlog. Speed matters, but I will always favour error-free work over rushing. If you are comfortable using either Excel or Google Sheets to keep everything organised, that will help us collaborate smoothly.

Deliverable
• A clean, fully populated spreadsheet that matches the source material exactly.

Before we begin, send me a brief note confirming:
1. Your estimated turnaround time.
2. How you normally double-check your work for accuracy.

That’s all I need right now—looking forward to working together.
